en.longDescription:
A company-targeting service to group together newspapers and magazines from around the world.

Note that as of June 2026, the recentmost non-Store version of PressReader that this Winget package is based on, lags far behind the recentmost Store version. The non-Store version does not offer any free-of-charge articles to non-companies either. Unless your PC has blocked Microsoft Store or is unable to use it, consider running «winget install 9WZDNCRFJ13B --force».
en.name: PressReader (Classic)
